label: Reconciliation
description: Resolving conflicting accounts of the same process into one map.
attribution: Distilled in FlowForge's own words from Lenny's Product Skills v2.0 (MIT) by Refound AI — github.com/refoundai/lenny-skills.
questions: Where do the two accounts disagree — owner, order, decision, or outcome?
What does each stakeholder believe happens at the disputed step?
What evidence or artifact would settle the disagreement?
Who must sign off on the reconciled version?
checks: One numbered story, not two maps
The disputed step is called out explicitly
Both stakeholders confirm the reconciled story
